detection.sql:
WITH b AS (SELECT d::DATE AS d, region, channel, category, SUM(converted) AS num, SUM(landed) AS den FROM commerce.sessions GROUP BY 1,2,3,4)
SELECT d, region, channel, category, SUM(num)/NULLIF(SUM(den),0) AS value, SUM(num) AS numerator, SUM(den) AS denominator
FROM b
WHERE region IN ('WEST','NORTH','SOUTH','EAST')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY 1
